build_pythia_vqa_model: build a Pythia multimodal VQA model by calling build() to initialize text and image embeddings
run_pythia_forward_pass: run a forward pass through Pythia with a sample_list containing text and image features
create_pythia_question_only_model: create a PythiaQuestionOnly model that processes only question text without image features
create_pythia_image_only_model: create a PythiaImageOnly model that processes only image features without question text
build_pythia_multihead_model: build a PythiaMultiHead model with feature projectors and multi-head image feature embeddings
